title: The Ultimate List of Affiliate Marketing Tips for SMBs and Startups

facts.fact: Salesforce's blog states that 81% of SMBs say customer referrals and affiliate marketing have helped them grow, citing its own SMB trends research report.
facts.quote: 81% of SMBs say customer referrals and affiliate marketing have helped them grow

facts.fact: The Salesforce blog article 'The Ultimate List Of Affiliate Marketing Tips For SMBs and Startups' is dated February 27, 2026.
The Salesforce article lists three components of an affiliate program: the advertiser, the affiliates, and optional affiliate networks that track referrals and handle commission payouts.
facts.quote: Affiliate networks (optional):** Platforms that track referrals and handle commission payouts.
